---
title: "simstim host rekey"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Replace a host's pinned host key, after you confirm.

```text
simstim host rekey <name> [flags]
```

Read the host's key again, offering no key and no password, show the pinned key and the new one, and pin the new one after you type the host's name. Run it only when you know why the key changed, such as after you reinstalled the host. Otherwise, do not connect.

## Examples

```sh
simstim host rekey my-vps
simstim host rekey my-vps --host-key SHA256:… --confirm my-vps
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--confirm <host>` | the name of the host, typed here instead of at the question |
| `--host-key <fingerprint>` | the SHA256 fingerprint that the new key must have, as ssh-keygen -lf prints it on the host |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
